path.id: Give me a summary of the VEFR world structure, specifically regarding branching references. How do they tie back to the World-tree representation?

g.id: The VEFR world structure is conceptually visualized as a modular, branching canopy. Each major world revision is a core trunk, while forks are literal "branches" extending from the base tree: 1. Core Trunk: Anchors the immutable canonical history of the universe. 2. Secondary Branches: Specialized lore containers containing optional narratives, client state configurations, or modular companion scripts. 3. Norse Cap leaf nodes: Instantiated instances that local agents can interact with directly. Branching references are monitored via the squirrel pet mechanism, which evaluates tree node integrity.
